dialogue.english: And upon you peace, thanks to God, I work as a nurse at the hospital.

dialogue.arabic: ما شاء الله، من كم سنة بتشتغِل هناك؟
dialogue.transliteration: ma shaa allah, min kam sana btshtaghil hinak?
dialogue.english: Wonderful, how many years have you been working there?

dialogue.transliteration: min thlath sneen, wil7amdulillah il-shaghul feeha tammaam.
dialogue.english: For three years, and thank God the work there is good.

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.arabic: وأنا بدري أدرِس هندسة بالجامعة.
dialogue.transliteration: w ana badri adris handasa bil-jaam3a.
dialogue.english: And I'm still studying engineering at university.

dialogue.speaker: أحمد
dialogue.arabic: في أي سنة أنت بالجامعة؟
dialogue.transliteration: fi ay sana inta bil-jaam3a?
dialogue.english: What year are you in at university?

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.arabic: بالسنة الثالثة، وأدُور على تدريب صيفي.
dialogue.transliteration: bil-sana ith-thalitha, w adoor 3ala tadreeb Saifu.
dialogue.english: In the third year, and I'm looking for a summer internship.

dialogue.speaker: أحمد
dialogue.arabic: إذا بتحتاج، أقدِر أسأل في المستشفى، دايم يحتاجون متدربين.
dialogue.transliteration: idha btahtaj, agdir as2al fil mustashfa, daim y7tajoon mitdarribeen.
dialogue.english: If you need, I can ask at the hospital, they always need trainees.

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.arabic: الله يخليك، هذا بيساعدني كتير.
dialogue.transliteration: allah ykhalliyak, hadha bysa3idni kteer.
dialogue.english: God keep you, that would help me a lot.

dialogue.speaker: أحمد
dialogue.arabic: ولا تقلق، بسأل بكرة وبحكيك.
dialogue.transliteration: wala tlaq, bas2al bukra wba7keelak.
dialogue.english: Don't worry, I'll ask tomorrow and tell you.

response.english: Yes, I like my job a lot.

pair.arabic: كم وقت بقي لك لحتى التخرج؟
pair.transliteration: kam wa2t baqi lak la7atta it-takharruj?

response.english: Two more years and I'll graduate.

dialogue.english: Good morning Fahad, how are you? Are you coming to the meeting?

dialogue.speaker: فهد
dialogue.arabic: صباح النور، الحمد لله، أي بجي. بس وصِلتني رسالة من المدير.
dialogue.transliteration: Sabaa7 in-noor, il7amdulillah, ayya bji. bass waSilni risala min il-mudeer.

dialogue.arabic: شنو بيبي المدير؟
dialogue.transliteration: shinu bybi il-mudeer?
dialogue.english: What does the manager want?

dialogue.arabic: أعتقد عن التقرير. أنا لما خلصت بعد.
dialogue.transliteration: a3taqid 3an it-tagreer. ana lamma khallaSt ba3d.
dialogue.english: I think about the report. I haven't finished it yet.

dialogue.arabic: لازم تخلصه بسرعة، في اجتماع الساعة عشرة.
dialogue.transliteration: laazim tkhallaSah bsor3a, fee ijtimaa3 is-saa3a 3ashara.
dialogue.english: You have to finish it quickly, there's a meeting at ten.

dialogue.speaker: فهد
dialogue.arabic: أي، وأنا معتم أخلصه قبل العصر.
dialogue.transliteration: ayya, w ana maa3tam akhlaSah 2abl il-3aSr.
dialogue.english: Yes, and I'm determined to finish it before afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: ممتاز. بالمناسبة، المديرية طلبت ساعات إضافية اليوم.
dialogue.transliteration: mumtaaz. bil-munaasba, il-mudirya Talab Sa3aat idaafya il-yoom.
dialogue.english: Great. By the way, the office requested overtime today.

dialogue.speaker: فهد
dialogue.arabic: حسن، بنقدر نخلص أكتر من الشغِل.
dialogue.transliteration: hasan, bngdir nkhallAs akthar min ish-shaghul.
dialogue.english: Good, we can finish more work.

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: وبعدين الراتب بيجي في آخر الشهر، وكلنا محتاجين.
dialogue.transliteration: w ba3dain ir-raatib byji fi aakhir ish-shahr, w killna muhtaajeen.
dialogue.english: And then the salary comes at the end of the month, and we all need it.

dialogue.speaker: فهد
dialogue.arabic: صدق، الحمد لله على كل حال.
dialogue.transliteration: Sidg, il7amdulillah 3ala kil haal.
dialogue.english: True, thank God anyway.

dialogue.english: Peace be upon you Sarah, why do you look tired?

dialogue.arabic: وعليكم السلام، عندي امتحان بكرة وما فهِمت المحاضرة كويس.

dialogue.english: Which subject are you studying?

dialogue.arabic: الكيمياء، والدكتور غايب اليوم، ما فيني أسأله.
dialogue.transliteration: il-kimya2, wid-doktor ghayib il-yoom, ma feeni as2alah.
dialogue.english: Chemistry, and the professor is absent today, I can't ask him.

dialogue.speaker: محمد
dialogue.arabic: أنا عندي محاضرة الساعة تسعة بكرة، لكن بقدِر أساعدك الحين.
dialogue.transliteration: ana 3indi mu7aaDra is-saa3a tis3a bukra, lakin bagdir asa3dik il-7een.
dialogue.english: I have a lecture at nine tomorrow, but I can help you now.

dialogue.speaker: سارة
dialogue.arabic: ياله، شكراً كتير.
dialogue.transliteration: yalah, shukran kteer.
dialogue.english: Wow, thank you so much.

dialogue.speaker: محمد
dialogue.arabic: لازم أسلّم الواجب قبل الجمعة، نروح المكتبة ندرس شوي؟
dialogue.transliteration: laazim asallim il-waajib 2abl il-jum3a, nroo7 il-maktaba nidris shwai?
dialogue.english: I have to submit the assignment before Friday, shall we go to the library and study?

dialogue.speaker: سارة
dialogue.arabic: مكتبة الجامعة مفتوحة لحتى الليل، ممتاز.
dialogue.transliteration: maktabat il-jaam3a maftoo7a la7atta il-lail, mumtaaz.
dialogue.english: The university library is open until night, perfect.

dialogue.speaker: محمد
dialogue.arabic: وأصحابي بالجامعة ناس تمام، بيساعدوا بعض.
dialogue.transliteration: w aS7abi bil-jaam3a nas tammaam, bysaa3do ba3aD.
dialogue.english: And my friends at university are good people, they help each other.

dialogue.speaker: سارة
dialogue.arabic: إن شاء الله تطلع نتيجتي تمام.
dialogue.transliteration: in shaa allah tTal3 nateejti tammaam.
dialogue.english: God willing my result comes out good.

dialogue.speaker: محمد
dialogue.arabic: إن شاء الله، وأنا كمان.
dialogue.transliteration: in shaa allah, w ana kamaan.
dialogue.english: God willing, and mine too.

dialogue.speaker: علياء
dialogue.arabic: حسن، شنو ناوي تسوي بعد ما تتخرج؟
dialogue.transliteration: hasan, shinu naawi tsawwi ba3d ma titkarraj?
dialogue.english: Hassan, what do you plan to do after you graduate?

dialogue.speaker: حسن
dialogue.arabic: صراحة لما قررت بعد، بس بفكر أكمل ماجستير.
dialogue.transliteration: sara7a lamma garrart ba3d, bass bfakkir akammil majesteer.
dialogue.english: Honestly I haven't decided yet, but I'm thinking of continuing a master's.

dialogue.speaker: علياء
dialogue.arabic: بأي مجال؟
dialogue.transliteration: bi2ay majal?
dialogue.english: In which field?

dialogue.speaker: حسن
dialogue.arabic: بمجال التجارة، وبعدين بفكر أسافر أشتغِل برا شوي.
dialogue.transliteration: bimajal it-tajara, w ba3dain bfakkir asaafir ashtghil barra shwai.
dialogue.english: In business, and then I'm thinking of traveling to work abroad a bit.

dialogue.speaker: علياء
dialogue.arabic: يا الله، وأنت يعني بتسافر لحالك؟
dialogue.transliteration: ya allah, w inta ya3ni btsaafir la7aalak?
dialogue.english: Wow, and you mean you'll travel alone?

dialogue.speaker: حسن
dialogue.arabic: أي، لكن بعد سنين برجع وأفتح مشروعي الخاص هنا.
dialogue.transliteration: ayya, lakin ba3d sneen brija3 w aftah7 mashroo3i il-khaaS hina.
dialogue.english: Yes, but after years I'll come back and open my own project here.

dialogue.speaker: علياء
dialogue.arabic: حلو الحلم، وأنا طموحي إني أصير محامية يوم من الأيام.
dialogue.transliteration: 7ilo il-7ilm, w ana tamoo7i inne aSeer mu7amya yom min il-ayyaam.
dialogue.english: Nice dream, and my ambition is to become a lawyer one day.

dialogue.speaker: حسن
dialogue.arabic: أكيد بتوصلي، أنتِ شاطرة في الدراسة.
dialogue.transliteration: akeed btwaSale, anti shaatra fil-dirasa.
dialogue.english: You'll definitely get there, you're smart in your studies.

dialogue.speaker: علياء
dialogue.arabic: الله يسمع منك، الحاجة الأساسية أهم شي أرتاح بشغِلي.
dialogue.transliteration: allah yisma3 mink, il-7aja il-asasya ahamm shi arta7 bishugli.
dialogue.english: God hear you, the main thing is that I'm comfortable in my work.

dialogue.speaker: حسن
dialogue.arabic: صدق كتير، الفلوس مهمة لكن مو كل شي.
dialogue.transliteration: Sidg kteer, il-floos muhimma lakin mu kil shi.
dialogue.english: Very true, money is important but not everything.

dialogue.speaker: علياء
dialogue.arabic: يلا الله يوفقك بمشروعك، والله معي بطموحي.
dialogue.transliteration: yalla allah ywaffgak bmashroo3ak, w allah ma3i bTamoo7i.
dialogue.english: Well, God grant you success in your project, and God be with me in my ambition.
